title: Quotation of providing various Hire vehicle for the departmental use for one year period from Mumbai based firms -Reg.
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations from Mumbai-based firms for hiring AC cars (hatchback, sedan, SUV, premium SUV, MUV), a 10/12 ton truck and a 20-seat AC tempo traveller, with driver and fuel, for local and outstation departmental use by the Mumbai Directorate for one year.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

scope.item: Schedule A (local): Hatchback (Maruti Suzuki Swift, WagonR, Tata Tiago, Tata Nexon, Hyundai Santro) - rate for 80km x 8hrs, per additional km beyond 80 km, per additional hr beyond 8 hrs
Schedule A (local): Sedan (Honda Amaze, Maruti Suzuki Dzire, Hyundai Xcent, Ford Aspire, Honda City)
Schedule A (local): SUV (Maruti Suzuki Ertiga, Vitara Brezza, Mahindra Scorpio, Maruti Suzuki XL6, Ford Eco sport, Mahindra XUV 300 & XUV 500, Toyota Innova)
Schedule A (local): Premium SUV (Toyota Innova Crysta, Honda CR-V)
Schedule B (outstation): same five vehicle types - rate for 300 km x 24 hrs, per additional km beyond 300 km, per night halt
Schedule C: Truck of 10/12 ton capacity - rate for 300 km / 24 hrs, per additional km beyond 300 km, per night halt
Schedule C: Tempo Traveller 20 seat capacity A.C - rate for 300 km / 24 hrs, per additional km beyond 300 km, per night halt

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed. Rates for AC vehicles only; GST % quoted separately. No rate increase during contract; toll taxes paid at actuals with proof; no advance payment; payment by bank transfer after invoices, logbook and service feedback. Penalties per Annex-III: third-party hire cost plus 10%/15% of daily hiring cost for non-deployment or breakdown without replacement; warning then 10%/15% (or 8%/10% for breakdown) with replacement; delay of 30 min or more warning then 5%/8%; driver misbehaviour Rs 1000/2000; intoxicated driver Rs 2500; unaddressed deficiencies Rs 500/800/1000.

period.completion: One year from date of issue of work order (extendable at same rate, terms and conditions)

eligibility: All vehicles with necessary permits/licenses: fitness certificate, PUC, full comprehensive insurance, road permit, registration certificate as per Motor Vehicles Act/RTO (commercial vehicles)
24-hour telephone facility with firm and drivers
specs: AC vehicles with driver and fuel on vehicle-day basis, local and outstation
Sticker 'ON GOVT OF INDIA DUTY' on front and rear glass; driver in RTO-approved clean dress code; no mobile phone use while driving
Separate duty slip/log book per vehicle with odometer readings; bills in triplicate certified by in-charges after each trip
notes: Scanned document with a poor OCR text layer; all 8 pages read from rendered images. Quotations in sealed envelope superscribed 'Quotation for Hire vehicle' to the Director, Deep Bhavan, M.G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai-400077 on or before 14/11/2025 16:00. No quantities of vehicle-days given. Listing gives no bid opening date.
